name: Variable-scoped Allow Resource (positive + negative)
note: Allow s3:GetObject on the caller's own bucket via ${aws:username}. The concrete-ARN match cannot be confirmed from the policy text, so a matching action degrades to CONDITIONAL rather than a definitive ALLOWED_BY_POLICY. An action outside the grant (s3:DeleteObject) is still certainly not-granted because the action pattern is concrete and does not match.
